title: When the Asset Turns
author: Ansel Kavanagh
blurb: August Vane, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
